fixed.issue: Composition construction validated an executor, then reread it for queue binding. The third read could substitute a foreign executor or reject a valid adapter.
fixed.change: Capture the validated executor and retain the existing two-read stability check. Five new regression/control cases cover third-read substitutions and unstable validation.

fixed.issue: The ordinary Vite server recursively scanned property-isolation/index.html without its diagnostic plugin, producing an unresolved virtual-module error and disabling dependency pre-bundling.
fixed.before: The full release log records Failed to run dependency scan for virtual:breditor-property-validator.
fixed.change: Use explicit ordinary HTML entries in vite.browser.config.ts from both Playwright and the manual clipboard launcher. Preserve default dependency discovery within those entries and all optional diagnostic configurations.
fixed.after: Three new configuration tests pass; the fresh 159-case matrix and 40-case WebKit run contain no dependency-scan error. Vite optimized parse5 successfully.
